source_resources.author: Hugging Face course contributors
source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Chapter 11.3: Dataset Preparation; Implementation with TRL
source_resources.version_or_verification_date: Public edition checked 2026-11-01; moving pages may change
source_resources.permission_basis: External hyperlink only; no third-party prose, exercises, code or translations are imported.
source_resources.prerequisites: Python, PyTorch, language-model training and the preceding chat-format lessons.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Sequenced templates, supervised fine-tuning and evaluation teaching with exercises/quizzes. LoRA method and memory claims are checked against the original paper, PEFT and the local parameter ledger, not accepted wholesale from Chapter 11.4.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Free reading; hosted exercises can require accounts, model downloads and a GPU. Chapter 11.4 overstates GPU-memory savings by implying only adapters occupy GPU memory; that sentence is not adopted.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Use the original localized explanations, exercises and checks already present in this activity; no external account or purchase is required for that fallback.

compared_candidates.license: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license / Open Access
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Retained for initialization and the low-rank method, not a beginner teaching sequence.
Retained for actual API and implementation defaults; reference documentation is not a complete teaching course.

source_resources.title: PyTorch Documentation: torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss
source_resources.author: PyTorch Core Development Team
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful reference under BSD 3-Clause open source license.
source_resources.prerequisites: Softmax probabilities, negative log likelihood, multi-class classification.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary specification for ignore_index=-100 behavior, weight averaging over unmasked tokens, and loss reduction arithmetic.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Mathematical formulation of masked cross-entropy and equivalent tensor implementations are provided in lesson code.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Keras cross-entropy loss with sample_weight masking; PyTorch ignore_index is the standard in transformer fine-tuning.
Functional cross-entropy with manual boolean masking; PyTorch ignore_index=-100 is our target implementation.

source_resources.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
source_resources.author: Long Ouyang, Jeffrey Wu, Xu Jiang, Diogo Almeida, Carroll Wainwright, Pamela Mishkin, et al.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Foundational InstructGPT paper defining the SFT objective: maximizing log-likelihood of demonstrator completions conditioned on prompts.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The conditional likelihood objective and prompt-conditioning derivations are completely formulated in the review.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Ziegler et al. Fine-Tuning Language Models from Human Preferences
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Earlier RLHF formulation on summarization; InstructGPT standardizes the prompt-response SFT training phase.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Chung et al. Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models (Flan-PaLM)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Focuses on massive multi-task scaling; InstructGPT details the exact prompt-conditioned loss setup.
